name: verifier-critic
context: Production pipelines where generated output must meet a rubric: a critic agent scores and annotates the generator's output and gates release until criteria pass.
tradeoffs: Doubles inference on the verified subset
Critic false positives block good output
anti_patterns: Judge without calibration against human labels
Rubric without anchored examples per score level
Forcing binary labels when evidence is insufficient
design_principles: Use boolean/categorical labels over numerical scores for consistency
Version rubric and pin judge model to explicit version
best_practices: Feed critic failures back into generator prompts
Run deterministic checks before judge evaluation
Calibrate judge against human experts targeting 0.80+ Spearman correlation
Use different model family for judge to avoid self-preference bias
references: Lightman et al., Let's Verify Step by Step, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.20050
